title: Statistical question
explanation: A question answered by collecting and analysing data with variation.

title: Statistical statement
explanation: A numerical claim/summary involving values, proportions, probabilities or predictions.

title: Arithmetic mean
explanation: Sum of values divided by number of values.

title: Median
explanation: Middle value after sorting; average the two middle values for even-sized data.

title: Outlier
explanation: A value that significantly deviates from the rest.

title: Data visualisation
explanation: Dot plots and graphs help display variation and occurrences.
